query.text: 请帮我照看老人搬东西，如果视线受阻有碰撞危险或发生意外摔倒，请及时提醒。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the elderly person moving things, and alert me immediately if their line of sight is blocked posing a collision risk, or if an accidental fall occurs.

annotation.text_zh: 前方有茶几，请注意脚下安全。
annotation.text_en: Coffee table ahead, please watch your step.

annotation.text_zh: 您摔倒了，请先别乱动，请附近的人查看并帮忙联系家人。
annotation.text_en: You have fallen. Please avoid moving hastily and ask someone nearby to check on you and help contact your family.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
